extraction_notes: All four main plans are standard subscription tiers. The page mentions "Custom pricing" at the bottom for growing orgs with complex needs, but no custom pricing tier with numbers is displayed, so it is not included. All plans include a free 14-day trial with no credit card required. Calling and SMS are usage-based add-ons charged separately. Premium Phone Numbers ($19/month per line) and Call Assistant ($50/month + usage) are listed as add-ons. The page describes Chloe as included on all plans with AI credits included monthly (500-2000 per user depending on plan), but additional credits can be purchased separately as usage-based add-ons. Features like "Workflows" are only in Growth and Scale, but Growth shows "Automated workflows" capability while Scale adds more advanced features like "Predictive dialer" and "Role-based access & permissions". The comparison table indicates "Workflows not included" for Solo and Essentials. I recorded "basic workflows" for Growth and Scale based on the automated workflows capability mentioned. Solo has a limit of 10,000 leads explicitly stated. All other plans show unlimited leads/contacts.
